title: Get the MMM data request history
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the details of historical Media Mix Modeling (MMM) data requests. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/history/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | from_date {Required} | string | Start date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time).

The start date cannot be earlier than four years ago. | | end_date {Required} | string | End date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/history/?from_date=2024-11-01&end_date=2024-12-03' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| historical_requests | string[] | A JSON-formatted string array that displays historical requests, providing details for each request.

For the fields `media_type` and `Status`, you might need to convert the returned integer values to string values in other MMM endpoints based on the following mapping:

  • Supported values for `media_type`:
    • `0`: corresponds to `All`.
    • `1`: corresponds to `Earned`.
    • `2`: corresponds to `Paid`.
  • Supported values for `Status`:
    • `1`: corresponds to `request received`.
    • `3`: corresponds to `in progress`.
    • `5`: corresponds to `completed - ready for download`.
    • `2`: corresponds to `failed`.
    • `4`: corresponds to `failed`.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "historical_requests": [ "{\"RequestID\":\"{{RequestID}}\",\"CreateTime\":\"2024-11-07T22:03:39Z\",\"Message\":\"{\\\"targets\\\":[{\\\"advertiser_id\\\":\\\"{{advertiser_id}}\\\"}],\\\"from_date\\\":\\\"20240729\\\",\\\"to_date\\\":\\\"20240829\\\",\\\"media_type\\\":2}\",\"Status\":5}", "{\"RequestID\":\"{{RequestID}}\",\"CreateTime\":\"2024-11-19T19:54:58Z\",\"Message\":\"{\\\"targets\\\":[{\\\"advertiser_id\\\":\\\"{{advertiser_id}}\\\"}],\\\"from_date\\\":\\\"20241104\\\",\\\"to_date\\\":\\\"20241108\\\",\\\"country_code\\\":[\\\"JP\\\"],\\\"media_type\\\":2}\",\"Status\":1}" ] } } (/code) ```
